hooks.command: git status --porcelain -- src/ | grep -q . && echo '{"systemMessage":"Reminder: update RELEASE-NOTES.md if these changes are user-facing."}' || true

echo '{"systemMessage": "Housekeeping: glance at CONTEXT.md. If you completed any todos, changed focus, or have new context that would help the next session — update it now. Keep the file under 120 lines."}'
